department: College of Veterinary Medicine & Biomedical Sciences

deadline.value: Submit by December 1 to be considered for the February recruiting event; later applicants can still be admitted if they secure a mentor.
deadline.quote: All prospective BIMS PhD students who submit a complete application by December 1 are eligible for invitation to the graduate research symposium and recruiting event in the Spring.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants living outside the US are unlikely to get one of the four rotation places, so in practice you need to find and confirm a faculty mentor for direct admission.
supervisor.quote: Applicants who do not currently reside in the United States are not eligible for the rotation program recruiting event and are unlikely to gain a spot in the rotation program. We encourage ALL applicants to peruse our Curricular Training Tracks to review current faculty/research and attempt to locate and confirm a mentor for direct admit purposes.

also.quote: Prospective PhD students have the option of applying for direct admission (under the mentorship of a specific faculty member) or to the PhD Rotation Program.

funding.value: Rotation students get a $26,000 first-year assistantship from the college; funding for direct admits comes from the faculty mentor and is not described.

entry_route.value: The pages checked do not state the degree needed to enter.

notes: Four curricular tracks. The rotation program takes four students a year, fall entry only.
name: Biomedical Sciences (BIMS) PhD
